label: SIMULATION — NOT PHYSICAL-SYSTEM VALIDATION

scenario.title: Expired authorization replay
scenario.attempted: Yesterday's genuine but expired defrost authority is replayed through the governed route: first by an unrecognized actor, then by its original holder.

submissions.label: Expired authority replayed by an unrecognized actor
Expired authority replayed by its original holder

outcome: No physical deviation. Product stayed at or below -18 °C (max -20.81 °C).

claims.basis: CMD-S7-REPLAY-ATTACKER: DENY (SIM_ACTOR_STANDING_NOT_ESTABLISHED, SIM_ACTOR_IS_NOT_GRANT_HOLDER, AUTHORITY_EXPIRED, COMMIT_BOUNDARY_REFUSED); executed=false · CMD-S7-REPLAY-HOLDER: DENY (AUTHORITY_EXPIRED, COMMIT_BOUNDARY_REFUSED); executed=false
Four authorized defrost cycles ran; the EIN raised no alert.
Chain valid: true (582 entries); sealed baseline unchanged: true; missing entry types: none.

unproven: Theft of a current, unexpired grant together with the holder's identity was not modelled.
Physical-system behaviour: the thermal model is illustrative and unvalidated.
Real controller protocols, network paths and attacker capabilities were not tested.
Detection depends on independent sensors existing, being installed correctly and staying independent of the compromised path.

baseline.label: SIMULATION — NOT PHYSICAL-SYSTEM VALIDATION
baseline.thresholdBasis: Configured for this simulation. -18 °C is a commonly cited frozen-storage temperature; site limits must come from the operator's food-safety plan and equipment documentation.

payload.note: The last authorized baseline is sealed and stored separately from observed reality.

simulationGroundTruth.note: Available only because this is a simulation. Never supplied to the EIN, the EIR or the AEA gate.
